scenes.title: What a law promises
scenes.viewerPurpose: Distinguish prediction from understanding why Allow a working formula to leave questions open Ask what evidence could choose between possibilities

cues.narration: Predicting what happens is different from knowing why it happens, or what could change it.

cues.narration: A formula can work beautifully without telling us everything about the world.

cues.narration: The book asks what evidence could help us choose between its more unusual possibilities.

cues.narration: What would reality have to do before we changed our minds?
